properties.description: Control is a supernatural third-person action-adventure in which you play the newly appointed Director of the Federal Bureau of Control, a secretive New York agency. After the Bureau's headquarters — the shifting, brutalist 'Oldest House' — is invaded by a reality-warping otherworldly force called the Hiss, you must explore a labyrinthine, ever-changing building, master telekinetic and psychic abilities, reclaim control of the facility, and uncover hidden, cosmic secrets that connect to a larger Remedy shared universe.

short_descriptions.value: Als neue Direktorin einer geheimen New Yorker Behörde musst du deren Hauptquartier von einer realitätsverzerrenden, übernatürlichen Macht zurückerobern, indem du Kräfte meisterst und verborgene Wahrheiten enthüllst.
Como nueva directora de una agencia secreta en Nueva York, debes recuperar su sede de una fuerza sobrenatural que altera la realidad dominando poderes y desvelando secretos ocultos.
En tant que nouvelle Directrice d'une agence secrète de New York, vous devez reprendre le siège envahi par une force surnaturelle en maîtrisant des pouvoirs et en découvrant des secrets cachés.
As the new Director of a secretive New York agency, you must reclaim its headquarters from a reality-warping otherworldly force by mastering supernatural powers and uncovering hidden truths.

properties.description: The Outer Worlds is a single-player first-person sci-fi RPG in which you awaken decades late from cryosleep to find the corporate-run Halcyon colony teetering on the edge of collapse; your choices, companions and character build determine how a sprawling, satirical conspiracy unfolds across multiple planets and space stations.

short_descriptions.value: Nach dem Erwachen Jahrzehnte später auf einem Kolonieschiff erkundest du eine von Konzernen regierte Weltraumkolonie; deine Entscheidungen decken eine Verschwörung auf, die Halcyon bedroht.
Awakening decades late on a colonist ship, you navigate a corporate-run space colony's factions and choices to uncover a conspiracy that threatens the Halcyon colony.
Al despertar décadas después en una nave colonizadora, exploras una colonia espacial dirigida por corporaciones y tus decisiones destapan una conspiración que amenaza Halcyon.
Réanime après des décennies à bord d'un vaisseau de colonisation, vous explorez une colonie dirigée par des corporations et vos choix révèlent une conspiration qui menace Halcyon.

properties.description: Prey is a first-person action-adventure video game set in an alternate timeline, where you explore a space station overrun by hostile aliens called the Typhon. Players control Morgan Yu, who must survive the threats using improvised weapons, stealth, and psionic powers acquired by machine grafting.

short_descriptions.value: A test subject on a space station must survive an alien outbreak while uncovering dark secrets about their past and the station's experiments.

akas.value: キングダムカム・デリバランス

properties.description: Kingdom Come: Deliverance is an open-world, first-person action role-playing game set in historically inspired medieval Bohemia, featuring realistic melee combat, a non-linear story, deep role-playing progression, and high production values.

short_descriptions.value: Un jeune homme est entraîné dans une violente guerre civile médiévale en Bohême historique, cherchant justice et survie grâce à un combat réaliste à la première personne et à des choix moraux.
Un joven se ve envuelto en una cruenta guerra civil medieval en la Bohemia histórica, buscando justicia y supervivencia mediante combate realista en primera persona y decisiones morales.
Ein junger Mann gerät in einen brutalen Bürgerkrieg im historischen Böhmen und sucht Gerechtigkeit sowie Überleben durch realistischen Erstpersonenkampf und moralische Entscheidungen.
A young man navigates a brutal medieval civil war in historically realistic Bohemia, seeking justice and survival through skill-based first-person combat and moral choices.

properties.description: Outer Wilds is an open-world exploration mystery in which the player explores a small solar system trapped in a repeating time loop, investigating extinct civilizations, planetary hazards, and hidden secrets to uncover why the loop exists.

short_descriptions.value: Explore a solar system trapped in an endless 22-minute time loop to uncover its mysteries before time resets.
Explorez un système solaire pris dans une boucle temporelle de 22 minutes pour percer son mystère avant que le temps ne se réinitialise.
Erkunde ein Sonnensystem, das in einer 22-minütigen Zeitschleife gefangen ist, und enthülle sein Geheimnis, bevor die Zeit zurückgesetzt wird.
Explora un sistema solar atrapado en un bucle temporal de 22 minutos para desvelar su misterio antes de que el tiempo se reinicie.

akas.value: チルドレン・オブ・モルタ 〜家族の絆の物語〜

properties.description: Children of Morta is a narrative-driven roguelike action-RPG that follows the Bergson family as they defend Mount Morta from a spreading Corruption. The game combines procedurally generated dungeons and hack-and-slash combat with a strong, character-focused story and persistent family progression between runs, presented in richly detailed pixel art and dynamic lighting.

short_descriptions.value: Une famille de héros défend le mont Morta contre une corruption croissante, explore des donjons procéduraux et découvre des récits intimes entre tentatives roguelike.
A family of heroes defends Mount Morta from a spreading Corruption, exploring procedurally generated dungeons while uncovering intimate, narrative-driven stories between roguelike runs.
Una familia de héroes defiende el Monte Morta de una corrupción creciente, explorando mazmorras procedurales y descubriendo historias íntimas entre intentos roguelike.
Eine Heldenfamilie verteidigt den Berg Morta gegen wachsende Verderbnis, erkundet prozedurale Dungeons und enthüllt intime Geschichten zwischen Roguelike-Versuchen.

properties.description: Mortal Shell is a deep action-RPG and Soulslike that tests your resilience in a shattered, gothic world. Players possess the remains of fallen warriors to gain unique abilities, explore hidden sanctums, and face punishing, tactical combat against formidable foes.

short_descriptions.value: Possédez des guerriers tombés pour survivre et combattre dans un monde gothique brisé, peuplé d'ennemis impitoyables et de sanctuaires cachés.
Possess fallen warriors to survive and fight through a shattered, gothic world filled with brutal foes and hidden sanctums.
Posee guerreros caídos para sobrevivir y luchar en un mundo gótico fragmentado, lleno de enemigos brutales y santuarios ocultos.
Übernehme gefallene Krieger, um in einer zerbrochenen, gotischen Welt voller gnadenloser Feinde und verborgener Zufluchtsorte zu überleben und zu kämpfen.

akas.value: เซกิโระ: แชโดวส์ดายทไวซ์
セキロ シャドウズ ダイ トゥワイス

properties.description: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice is a third-person action-adventure game with RPG elements set in a dark, fictionalized late 1500s Sengoku Japan; players control a one-armed shinobi tasked with rescuing his young lord and exacting revenge, using precise, skill-based combat, grappling tools, stealth, and a revival mechanic that lets the protagonist come back from death to continue fights. The game emphasizes difficult boss encounters, vertical traversal, and strategic posture-based duels.

short_descriptions.value: A lone one-armed shinobi must rescue his young lord and seek vengeance in late 1500s Sengoku Japan, using precise combat, stealth, and a unique ability to revive after death.
Un shinobi manco debe rescatar a su joven señor y buscar venganza en la Japón Sengoku del siglo XVI, usando combate preciso, sigilo y la habilidad de revivir.
Un shinobi à un bras doit sauver son jeune seigneur et venger l'injustice dans le Japon Sengoku du XVIe siècle, mêlant combat précis, furtivité et résurrection.
Ein einarmiger Shinobi muss seinen jungen Herrn retten und Rache im Japan der Sengoku‑Zeit des 16. Jahrhunderts suchen, mit präzisem Kampf, Schleichen und Wiederbelebung.

akas.value: メトロ エクソダス
เมโทรเอ็กโซดัส

properties.description: Metro Exodus follows Artyom and a band of survivors as they leave the ruins of the Moscow Metro and travel across a post-apocalyptic Russian landscape over the course of a year, exploring large sandbox levels, managing survival resources, and following a cinematic, narrative-driven campaign.

short_descriptions.value: Nachdem das Moskauer Metro-Netz nicht mehr sicher ist, machen sich Artyom und Überlebende auf eine einjährige Reise durch das postapokalyptische Russland, um eine neue Heimat zu finden und gefährlichen Bedrohungen zu begegnen.
After the Moscow Metro is no longer safe, a group of survivors led by Artyom embarks on a year-long journey across post-apocalyptic Russia to find a new home and confront deadly threats.
Après la chute du métro de Moscou, Artyom et des survivants entament un périple d'un an à travers la Russie post-apocalyptique pour trouver un nouveau foyer et affronter de graves dangers.
Tras el colapso del metro de Moscú, Artyom y un grupo de supervivientes emprenden un viaje de un año por la Rusia posapocalíptica en busca de un nuevo hogar y para enfrentar peligros mortales.

properties.description: Generation Zero is an open-world first-person action-survival game set in an alternate 1980s Sweden where the population has vanished and hostile robotic machines roam the countryside; players scavenge, craft, and cooperate (up to four players) to uncover the mystery and fight back.

short_descriptions.value: In 1980s Sweden, abandoned towns are overrun by hostile machines and you must explore, scavenge, and team up to uncover the mystery and fight back.
En la Suecia de los años 80, localidades abandonadas están invadidas por máquinas hostiles; explora, reúne recursos y únete a amigos para descubrir la verdad y contraatacar.
En Suède dans les années 80, des villes abandonnées sont envahies par des machines hostiles; explorez, récupérez des ressources et faites équipe pour découvrir la vérité et riposter.
Im Schweden der 1980er sind Orte verlassen und von feindlichen Maschinen besetzt; erkunde, sammle Ressourcen und verbünde dich mit Freunden, um das Geheimnis zu lüften und zurückzuschlagen.

properties.description: Hob is an action-adventure game set in a mysterious world filled with puzzles and challenges. Players explore the wilderness, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the lore of an open world as an adventurer equipped with a unique mechanical glove.

short_descriptions.value: A hero embarks on a journey to transform a mysterious world, uncovering its secrets and restoring balance.

properties.description: Set in a dystopian, near-future world where environmental collapse and automation have hollowed out society, The Surge puts players in the role of a laborer outfitted with an exoskeleton who must fight through hostile machines, corrupted systems and corporate forces to survive. The game emphasizes tightly tuned, limb-targeting melee combat, modular equipment upgrades harvested from enemies, and a character progression system built around crafting and implanting exo-modules. The setting is grim and oppressive, mixing science-fiction corporate horror with Soulslike difficulty and loot-driven progression.

short_descriptions.value: In einer verfallenden, überbevölkerten Zukunft nutzt ein Arbeiter ein Exoskelett, um gegen feindliche Maschinen und Konzerne zu kämpfen, zu überleben und sich zu verbessern.
In a decaying, overpopulated future, a worker uses an exoskeleton to fight hostile machines and corporate forces to survive and upgrade himself.
Dans un futur décadent et surpeuplé, un travailleur utilise un exosquelette pour combattre des machines hostiles et des intérêts corporatifs afin de survivre et s'améliorer.
En un futuro decadente y sobrepoblado, un obrero usa un exoesqueleto para combatir máquinas hostiles y fuerzas corporativas para sobrevivir y mejorar sus capacidades.

properties.description: Disco Elysium is an open-world, narrative-driven role-playing game in which you play a detective with amnesia and a unique internal skill system; you explore a decaying city, interrogate unforgettable characters, solve (or botch) crimes, take bribes, and shape your personality and moral alignment through choices and skill interactions.

short_descriptions.value: Un détective amnésique enquête sur un meurtre dans une ville en déclin, utilisant des compétences intérieures et des choix qui façonnent l'enquête et son destin.
An amnesiac detective investigates a murder in a decaying city, using inner skills and player choices to shape the investigation and his fate.
Ein amnestischer Ermittler untersucht einen Mord in einer verfallenden Stadt und nutzt innere Fertigkeiten sowie Entscheidungen, die die Untersuchung und sein Schicksal formen.
Un detective amnésico investiga un asesinato en una ciudad decadente, usando habilidades internas y decisiones del jugador para moldear la investigación y su destino.

properties.description: CrossCode is a retro-inspired 2D action RPG that pairs 16-bit SNES-style pixel graphics with fluid physics, fast-paced melee/shooting combat and Zelda-like dungeon puzzles, all wrapped in a sci-fi mystery narrative set inside a virtual MMO-like world.

short_descriptions.value: Dans un MMO rétro de science-fiction, un joueur résout des énigmes, maîtrise des combats rapides et explore des donjons pour découvrir la vérité sur une identité fragmentée.
En un MMO retro de ciencia ficción, un jugador resuelve puzles, domina combates rápidos y explora mazmorras para descubrir la verdad sobre una identidad fragmentada.
In a retro-styled sci-fi MMO, a lone player solves puzzles, masters fast action combat and explores dungeons to uncover the truth behind a fragmented identity.
In einem retro-futuristischen Sci‑Fi-MMO löst ein Spieler Rätsel, meistert schnelle Kämpfe und erkundet Dungeons, um die Wahrheit über seine fragmentierte Identität zu enthüllen.

akas.value: เฮดีส (วิดีโอเกม)

properties.description: Hades is a rogue-like dungeon crawler where players control Zagreus, the son of Hades, as he attempts to escape from the Underworld. The game is set in a Greek mythology-inspired world and combines fast-paced hack-and-slash combat with a rich narrative and character interactions.

short_descriptions.value: A son of Hades seeks to escape the Underworld, uncovering family secrets and confronting his father's will along the way.

akas.value: ฮาล์ฟ-ไลฟ์: แอลิกซ์

properties.description: Half-Life: Alyx is Valve's virtual-reality return to the Half-Life universe, a VR-set prequel to Half-Life 2 where you play Alyx Vance leading a desperate resistance against the Combine; the game emphasizes environmental interaction, physics-based puzzles, exploration and visceral first-person combat, built from the ground up for VR with high-fidelity visuals and detailed worldbuilding.

short_descriptions.value: Als Alyx Vance führst du in dieser VR-Prequel zu Half‑Life 2 die Widerstandsbewegung gegen die Combine, löst Rätsel, erkundest und kämpfst ums Überleben.
Dans la peau d'Alyx Vance, vous menez la résistance contre la Combine dans une précule VR de Half‑Life 2, mêlant énigmes, exploration et combats viscéraux.
Como Alyx Vance, lideras a la resistencia contra la Combine en una precuela en VR de Half‑Life 2, usando puzles, exploración y combate visceral para sobrevivir.
As Alyx Vance, you lead a daring resistance against the Combine in a VR-crafted prequel to Half-Life 2, using puzzles, exploration and visceral combat to survive.

properties.description: Kenshi is a free-roaming, squad-based sandbox RPG that emphasizes open-ended play over a fixed narrative: recruit, train, equip and lead characters to survive, trade, craft, build and fight in a harsh, lawless world. Players can be traders, slavers, warlords, farmers, thieves or fodder for cannibals while researching and crafting gear and building settlements.

short_descriptions.value: Ein offenes Sandbox-RPG, in dem du Charaktere rekrutierst und führst, um in einer rauen, gesetzlosen Welt zu überleben, zu handeln, Gegenstände herzustellen und zu kämpfen.
Un RPG bac à sable ouvert où vous recrutez et dirigez des personnages pour survivre, commercer, fabriquer et combattre dans un monde dur et sans loi.
Un RPG sandbox abierto en el que reclutas y diriges personajes para sobrevivir, comerciar, fabricar y luchar en un mundo duro y sin ley.
An open-ended squad-based sandbox RPG where you recruit and lead characters to survive, trade, craft, and fight in a harsh, lawless world.

properties.description: RAGE 2 is a vibrant, post-apocalyptic open world first-person shooter. Set in a dystopian world brought to ruin by an asteroid impact, players step into the shoes of a ranger named Walker, the last survivor of Vineland, to take on the tyrannical Authority that threatens the Wasteland's survival. The game combines intense gunplay with vehicular combat and various superpower abilities.

short_descriptions.value: In a post-apocalyptic world, the last Ranger battles factions and mutants to stop a tyrannical military power threatening humanity's survival.

akas.value: เดธสแตรนดิง
デス・ストランディング

properties.description: Besieged by death's tide at every turn, Sam Bridges must brave a world utterly transformed by the Death Stranding. Carrying the stranded remnants of the future in his hands, Sam embarks on a journey to reunite the shattered world one step at a time in a cinematic, narrative-driven open-world adventure that blends exploration, stealth, and asynchronous social mechanics.

short_descriptions.value: Sam Bridges muss ein verwandeltes, postapokalyptisches Amerika durchqueren, um isolierte Städte zu verbinden und das Geheimnis des Death Stranding zu lüften.
Sam Bridges debe atravesar una América transformada y postapocalíptica para reconectar ciudades aisladas y desvelar el misterio del Death Stranding.
Sam Bridges doit traverser une Amérique post‑apocalyptique transformée pour reconnecter des cités isolées et percer le mystère du Death Stranding.
Sam Bridges must traverse a transformed, post-apocalyptic America to reconnect isolated cities and uncover the mystery behind the Death Stranding.

properties.description: In Wasteland 3 you command a squad of Desert Rangers in a brutal post-nuclear Colorado, searching for aid from the self-proclaimed Patriarch while building a base, customizing a battle truck, recruiting and training Rangers, and making brutal ethical choices as you fight factions, cultists and sibling rivalries across frozen wastelands. The game is a squad-based RPG from inXile Entertainment with challenging tactical turn-based combat, deep character customization, vehicle upgrades and a reactive story shaped by player decisions.

short_descriptions.value: Comanda a un escuadrón de Desert Rangers enviado a Colorado para conseguir ayuda, luchando contra facciones y tomando decisiones duras que moldean un mundo postapocalíptico reactivo.
Führe ein Squad der Desert Rangers nach Colorado, um Hilfe zu sichern, kämpfe gegen Fraktionen und triff brutale Entscheidungen, die eine reaktive postapokalyptische Welt formen.
Dirige une escouade de Desert Rangers envoyée au Colorado pour obtenir de l'aide, combattant factions et dilemmes moraux qui façonnent un monde post-apocalyptique réactif.
Command a squad of Desert Rangers sent to Colorado to secure aid, battling factions and making brutal choices that shape a reactive post-apocalyptic world.
